name: Scientific Research and Experimental Development (SR&ED) Tax Credit
eligibilitySummary: Tax credit for Canadian businesses conducting R&D. Covers eligible expenditures on scientific research and experimental development. Available to all sizes of businesses across Canada.

funding.description: 15-35% of eligible R&D expenditures. Enhanced rate for CCPCs (Canadian-Controlled Private Corporations) on first $500K of expenditures.

application.applicationRequirements: File T661 with corporate tax return. Must demonstrate technological advancement, scientific uncertainty, and systematic investigation.
